$comment: Where a stage may run. Production is hard-disabled: synthetic gigs would appear to real workers and fire real push notifications. 'staging' points at the dev project, which real testers use too; prefer a dedicated staging project (set projectId + config + enabled).

emulator.$functionsNote: functions/src/region.ts deploys to us-central1 for any project that is not simpleproject-8ff7a, which includes this demo project.

webConfig.$comment: Fill from lib/firebase_options.dart (web) for the staging project. Web API keys are not secrets but are restricted by referrer/API.

warnings: Shared with real dev testers: synthetic gigs appear in their gig lists.
onOpenGigPosted reads every available user per gig and may push to real dev devices within 10 km of synthetic gig locations.
Email/password sign-in must be enabled in this project for synthetic accounts.

production.reason: Never load-test production. The runner refuses this environment even with an approval.
